diagnosis: Malignant rhabdoid tumour of the kidney

diagnosis: Malignant rhabdoid tumour of the kidney
legend: Absence of SMARCB1 (INI1) immunostaining in tumour cells, with retention in normal cells (which serve as an internal positive control).

diagnosis: Malignant rhabdoid tumour of the kidney
legend: Contrast-enhanced axial CT showing a heterogeneous mass with an indistinct margin in the central portion of the left kidney, with invasion to the renal pelvis and extracapsular spread with encasement of the renal vessels, aorta, and inferior vena cava. There is an associated enlargement of retroperitoneal lymph nodes.

diagnosis: Malignant rhabdoid tumour of the kidney
legend: Contrast-enhanced coronal reformatted CT showing a heterogeneous mass arising from the lower pole of the left kidney, with extracapsular spread and encasement of the renal vessels, aorta, and inferior vena cava. There is obstructive dilatation of the upper pole calyces.
